title: A finite retained representation does not make integration free
statement: For retained dimension d,the conditional trace has global log-Lipschitz a^2<=beta n tr B. A sufficient Gaussian cutoff/grid uses R^2=8(a^2+dlog2+log(1/eta)),L=R sqrt(d)+a and Q=ceil(2RL sqrt(d)/eta)^d conditional calls. Every call,failure budget proportional to totaldelta/Q,Gaussian tail,positive summation/transfer precision and scalar shift is paid. The class is polynomial in n at fixed rank,temperature,activity,accuracy,norms and bulk margin,with degree depending on retained temporal dimension. It is not precision-FPRAS or f(r)poly(n); beta growing for general ground energy invalidates fixed dimension. Four-spin sufficient Q~2.89e31 is a real practical limitation,not a refutation of the conditional tractability theorem. B0,d0 skips the integral. No large normalizer was computed.
